author: steven5703
body:
So, I use this mod called "VoxelMap", which has a radar built into it. I use the radar on different servers, but not on avicus. I disable it in the hub.

What it looks like on avicus:

Anyway, I noticed this on kohi:
 

"Server disabled radar" I'm assuming you guys can figure out a way to disable voxelmap radar on avicus also? Some people may not know that it's illegal. I used to use it in mczone before I joined the forums.

Also radar is almost impossible to detect unless they record with radar on or take a screenshot with radar on. So instead of trying to find people using this mod, disable it entirely :P
I know there's many other mods out there, but this one is pretty popular.
